$ schedule backup
back up ["database" "uploads"] from 2026-10-12T02:00:00Z every 12h0m0s, keep 30 days
[exit 0]

$ SCHEDULE_BACKUP_EVERY=6h schedule backup --flag-debug
  OPTION            VALUE                   SOURCE
  --config          "schedule.toml"         default
  --every           6h0m0s                  env SCHEDULE_BACKUP_EVERY
  --retention-days  30                      key backup.retention.days of schedule.toml
  --start           2026-10-12T02:00:00Z    key backup.start of schedule.toml
  --targets         ["database" "uploads"]  key backup.targets of schedule.toml
back up ["database" "uploads"] from 2026-10-12T02:00:00Z every 6h0m0s, keep 30 days
[exit 0]

$ schedule -c broken.toml backup
schedule: backup: invalid --every "12" from key backup.every of broken.toml: time: missing unit in duration "12"
[exit 2]

$ schedule backup >/dev/full
schedule: main: write the schedule: transcript: no space left on device
[exit 1]
